youtube.title: Why Microwave Doors Are Full of Tiny Holes 🍲 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The metal mesh in a microwave door works as a Faraday cage. Microwaves in a home oven have a wavelength of about 12 centimeters, far larger than the holes in the mesh, so they cannot pass through. Visible light has a wavelength thousands of times smaller, so it passes through easily and you can watch your food.
